blind.description: A heavy stone sarcophagus or tomb chest with a curved, barrel-vaulted lid reinforced with three carved transverse stone bands and one longitudinal central band. The rectangular base has stepped corner pillars, a raised lower plinth trim, and recessed panels on the sides featuring a relief-carved circular emblem with an equal-armed cross. The surfaces are solid, continuous, and cleanly sculpted in a stylized, hand-painted video game asset style, with weathered tan/brown stone textures and greenish moss or aged patina on the upper surfaces of the lid. The base rests flat directly on the ground plane without any separate display plinth.
blind.from_above: A rounded rectangular stone lid featuring a central longitudinal rib crossed by three perpendicular arched stone straps, dividing the curved top into six recessed mossy stone panels.
blind.height_vs_figure: About half the height of the figure (around 2.5 to 3 ft tall) and roughly 5 to 6 ft long, slightly shorter in length than the figure's full height.
